original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Eliminate unchanged-head pinner blob reads from the complete repaired PR6319/PR6357 scanner, preserving the exact report and exit behavior.
scope_change_reason: Original verifier-engineering step on a pending static byte scanner; predecessor repair correctness is a cited dependency, not an audit deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Tooling side result: reduce duplicate immutable blob loading during exact-source intake. This does not change a supplier invoice or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the first exact complete-report-preserving read reduction; report timing as inconclusive unless the complete-command benchmark separates.
evidence: README preservation proof and verify.py complete fixed-history report comparison, actual blob-call counters and synthetic changed/unchanged pinner controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can the tree-wide digest search avoid decompressing repeated objects without changing its text/binary or matching semantics?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The measured Git search dominates the complete scanner.
open_questions.first_step: Specify an immutable blob-ID deduplication algorithm and compare every complete pin row on one historical diff.
open_questions.blocked_by: Filename expansion, grep binary classification and every substring match must be preserved; no such implementation is supplied.
